Text:
One single continuous photograph — no panels, grids, or split frames.

PRIORITY ORDER — when instructions conflict, the lower number wins
1. The uploaded image's composition and geometry.
2. The exact people and vehicle counts given below.
3. The historical transformation for the target year.
4. The specific period details listed — each only where the geometry has room
   for it; one with nowhere to go is left out, never forced into the roadway.
5. Add nothing that is not asked for — no extra businesses, signs, vehicles,
   people, logos or advertisements.

Use the uploaded photo as the exact base composition. The street in the source
is empty — populate it with the people and vehicles specified below. Remove the
modern businesses, logos, brands, storefront names, banners and advertisements
visible in the source image, and replace them only with the period signage
specified below.

PRESERVE
Keep the uploaded image's composition, camera angle, geometry, buildings,
roads and permanent structures exactly as they are. Do not redraw,
reposition or restyle them. Change only what the sections below ask for.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Create a TRUE 9:16 vertical portrait. Expand the SAME scene naturally above
(sky) and below (street/pavement) as canvas extension — do not stretch or
distort the source geometry.

TRANSFORM TO 1985
Reagan era prosperity. A 1985 motel still filling most nights — a backlit plastic sign at the road, a soft-drink machine glowing outside the office, and the walkway swept.

CONDITION: busy — customers present, high activity, all pumps in use

PERIOD DETAILS
- large logo signs on pylons
- numbered room doors in a uniform row, repainted a darker color than the trim
- awnings with bold stripe patterns
- main sign: "Quality Inn" on the pylon out by the road, the chain's own sign shape and colors, with a lit VACANCY panel below it
- window signs: 'FREE HBO', 'VACANCY'
- a drink machine with one dead selection button
- a plastic patio chair beside a door, sun-faded on one side
Typography: bold geometric sans-serif, early computer-influenced fonts.
Place each detail where it plausibly belongs — sidewalk, storefront, lot edge, under an overhang. If there is nowhere for one, leave it out; nothing stands in the roadway or a driving lane.

SIGNAGE RESTRICTION
The only readable text anywhere in the image is:
'Quality Inn'
'FREE HBO'
'VACANCY'
Do not render any other readable words, business names, slogans, advertisements, logos or brand names. Lettering that appears elsewhere must be too small, too distant or too weathered to read as words.

PEOPLE
EXACTLY 1 people TOTAL: 1 distant, at the far edge of the lot. Grouped in pairs, threes, and singles.
- someone reading the rate card taped inside the office glass
- a clerk propping the office door open with a wedge
- a grandmother clutching a coupon flyer
Clothing: men in acid wash jeans, windbreakers; women in big permed hair, leg warmers. Fashion palette: neon pink, electric blue, purple. No posing or eye contact. All people stay on the lot apron, at the building entrance, or beside parked vehicles — never standing, sitting, or walking in the road or driving lanes.

VEHICLES
EXACTLY 2 period vehicles, all different:
- 1982-1988 Chevrolet Celebrity — boxy front-wheel drive sedan — silver
- 1980-1985 Cadillac Seville — sharp formal lines, bustleback — burgundy
Parked with gaps. Where a model is listed with a year range, render the 1985 model year specifically — only styling, trim and features available in 1985, nothing introduced later. No vehicle newer than 1985.
Parked vehicles sit nose-in or angled into the lot, evenly spaced; none parallel-parked along the street, none blocking a driveway apron. Keep the driveway aprons and the drive lanes through the lot clear.
PLACEMENT: all parked in the lot, nose-in to marked stalls, with an empty stall between them. No vehicle in the same spot as any other era.

ENVIRONMENT
- road markings: yellow center line, white edge lines, painted crosswalks
- utilities: overhead power lines standard, wooden utility poles

TREES
- silver maple tree at lot edge beside the pylon sign: clearly smaller than in the base image — about 55% of its canopy there, thinner trunk
Tree sizes MUST follow this specification even where they differ from the base image.

PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE
COLOR photograph — Kodacolor VR 200 or Fujicolor 100 look.
Color: slightly cool tones compared to 1970s. Grain: moderate grain, cleaner than 1975.
Photorealistic — NOT black-and-white, no HDR.
Light: warm, bright afternoon daylight, clear sky with light cloud, soft natural shadows — a fine, ordinary day.

PRIVACY
Blur all faces and license plates.
SelectedVehicles: 1982-1988 Chevrolet Celebrity — boxy front-wheel drive sedan
1980-1985 Cadillac Seville — sharp formal lines, bustleback
